score_contract.1: Complete corresponding public query/contract with no identified material valid-domain gap; hard numerator only.

score_contract.0.5: Actual prototype with major parameters/object behavior missing.
score_contract.0.25: Thin payload or convenience while the main object/protocol is absent.

methodology.dedup: Maximum evidence-backed score per canonical upstream id, never sum Moon wrappers/overloads/forwarding/inherited reachability.

methodology.scope: API attachment estimate only, not complete Python semantics, parameter combinations, image fidelity, host support or effort remaining.
methodology.verification: Existing accepted original-source guides and code inspection; this audit runs no Moon gates and does not infer maturity from test counts/LOC.
methodology.unverified_bounds: 0..0.5 is an explicit unresolved mapping interval, not free credit in the hard numerator.
methodology.absent: No mapped public implementation in the inspected port, including major unimplemented classes/systems.

limitations: No callable is scored complete solely because a Moon spelling equals a source spelling.

A verified scoped status normally scores 0.75 because the documented typed/source/math profile materially narrows valid public domains. Only a few individually justified full-contract queries score 1.
Unresolved convenience fields, adapters and external datetime/dateutil support do not count as Matplotlib methods.
Public API granularity weights a tiny getter like a large class; inspect group and strict/method-only sensitivities before interpreting a percentage.
Private implementation algorithms and helpers do not grow the public API numerator; their influence appears in linked public behavior.
Class attachment is downgraded when a large object/constructor protocol remains missing even if several methods are verified.

Lower/upper bounds are classification sensitivities of the audited correspondence model, not statistical confidence intervals or mathematical bounds on all Python semantics. Unrecognized possible correspondences remain explicit rather than receiving free optimistic credit.
